title: Figure 19: Neuroprosthetic interface mockup - model head with exposed brain (Duke)
description: Photograph of a museum-style display of a white model head with an exposed brain, with a gooseneck-mounted device positioned over the top of the brain and a cable leading to a small display unit on a black base. The caption reads "Figure 19. A Neuroprosthetic Interface. Adapted to the needs of a quadriplegic for control of his environments (Duke University)." It accompanies the section "Bionics and Neurointerfaces."
